faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Institute of Technology Agartala (NIT Agartala) for filling up faculty positions under contract.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post announced in this recruitment notification is Professor of Practice in the National Institute of Technology Agartala.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of the completed offline application form is 26 October 2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for NIT Agartala Professor of Practice?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Interested candidates need to download, fill out, and send the physical application form to the designated address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Professor of Practice position is set at 70 years as specified in the recruitment rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary for the Professor of Practice post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Professor of Practice position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 1,20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Applicants require a Bachelor and Post-graduate degree in a related discipline from a recognized University or Institute, with a Ph.D. being desirable.

faq.question: Q8. Is prior industrial experience mandatory for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must possess a minimum of 20 years of significant domain experience from reputed industries, government sectors, or research organizations.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Nil, meaning there is no fee required to apply for this position.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application form directly from the official website of NIT Agartala at www.nita.ac.in.
